overview: The girl has heard that her cousin is dead, and by whose hand. You had written her a passage that told the yard what the yard had already seen. You struck it, eleven lines. You left her one turn and fewer words. The margin says trust the boy.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Cut the eleven lines, wrote the turn, and set the margin.

assets.name: Romeo and Juliet
assets.disposition: Struck eleven lines and kept one turn for her

summary: Struck eleven lines and kept one turn for her
